title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered One Thousand Four Hundred and Eleven, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1999_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item B-362.12, appendix A, title B, Highways (Feeder and Secondary Roads), page one hundred sixty-eight-A, for the Province of Negros Oriental, of Republic Act Numbered One thousand four hundred and eleven is hereby amended to read as follows:
"B-362.12: Doldol Junction-Bontod Feeder Road—5 Kms. New road GR
75.00
50.00
10.00
30.00
100.00
25.00 1"

Item B-362.17, appendix A, title B, Highways (Feeder and Secondary Roads), page one hundred seventy-A, for the Province of Negros Oriental, of Republic Act Numbered One thousand four hundred and eleven is hereby amended to read as follows:
"B-362.17: Lipayo-Mag-aso-Kanghangin Feeder Road, Dauin—Construction— 7 kms.
GR 105 105 35 20 10 1"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
